description: This file contains an abstract class implementation for handling JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), including parsing, validation, and access to token components.

classes.name: AbstractJsonWebToken
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the JsonWebToken interface, providing JWT parsing, validation, and component access methods.

methods.name: AbstractJsonWebToken(JsonWebToken)
methods.description: Constructor copying data from another JsonWebToken instance.

methods.name: AbstractJsonWebToken(String)
methods.description: Constructor parsing a JWT string into header, body, and signature components.

methods.name: tryToDecodeJwtPart(String)
methods.description: Decodes a JWT part from Base64 and parses it into a JsonObject, with error handling.

methods.name: decodeJwtPart(String)
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded JWT part into a JsonObject.

methods.name: getHeader()
methods.description: Returns the JWT header as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getBody()
methods.description: Returns the JWT body as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getToken()
methods.description: Returns the raw JWT token string.

methods.name: getKeyId()
methods.description: Returns the Key ID from the JWT header.

methods.name: getIssuer()
methods.description: Returns the issuer claim from the JWT body.

methods.name: getAudience()
methods.description: Returns the audience claim as an Audience object.

methods.name: getScopes()
methods.description: Returns the list of scopes from the JWT.

methods.name: getExpirationTime()
methods.description: Returns the expiration time as an Instant.

methods.name: isExpired()
methods.description: Checks if the token is expired based on current time.

methods.name: equals(Object)
methods.description: Checks equality based on token components.

methods.name: hashCode()
methods.description: Generates hash code based on token components.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the JWT components.
